_doc: Light budget pass (20 Nov 2026). Edit, then run LightBudgetPass20261120 --steps install,mira,verify (-nographics). 'merge': keepers get intensityScale x their ORIGINAL intensity (originals.json), the 'retire' lights get their Light component disabled. 'budget' sets LightBudget fields. 'priorities': ranking multipliers by path substring. 'noPool': lamps that fade without a pool. 'mira': Basic General lamp re-aim (aimAt world point, from the recorded original). Re-running NightFacadePass would undo the Mira re-aim.
